question.text: Calculate value of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">E</mi><msub><mrow><mo>°</mo></mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow></msub></math> . If  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">E</mi><msub><mrow><mo>°</mo></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow></msub></math> for the cell reaction,  <math><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mo>→</mo><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> is 1.89 V. If  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">E</mi><msub><mrow><mo>°</mo></mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></mrow></mrow></mrow></msub></math>   <math><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>-</mo><mn>0.28</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math>

solution.text:
In this cell Co is oxidised and it acts as anode and Ce acts as cathode.

ECell0=ECathode0-EAnode0=1.89=ECell0-(-0.28)

ECell0=1.89-0.28=1.61 Volts.
